mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_memory_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory_profile (user_id, source_summary, profile_summary, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sourceSummary}, #{profileSummary}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_summary = VALUES(source_summary), profile_summary = VALUES(profile_summary), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_memory_fact WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY memory_type, confidence DESC, evidence_count DESC, updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory_fact (user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, confidence, evidence_count, source, source_summary, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{confidence}, #{evidenceCount}, #{source}, #{sourceSummary}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE confidence = LEAST(0.95, GREATEST(confidence, VALUES(confidence)) + 0.05), evidence_count = evidence_count + VALUES(evidence_count), source = VALUES(source), source_summary = VALUES(source_summary), deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory_profile SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_memory_fact SET deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
